Hi Dana — great to hear the quote is signed, congrats to you and the team. Quick answers inline below.

1) CS ownership: Monica Patel will be your primary Customer Success owner for onboarding and the first 90 days. Monica will run weekly 30–45 minute syncs for the first six weeks and then switch to biweekly. Monica is cc'd here and will follow up with a calendar invite and a first-week agenda.

2) Data ingestion runbook: We have a standard ingestion template we use for EMR/analytics customers; I'll attach it. It contains expected field mappings, sample payloads, and common troubleshooting checks. For anything custom Javier flags, Monica's team will produce an intake mapping doc in the first week of kickoff.

Kickoff window: Feb 22 is workable for us; Monica will propose a firm date after checking resource availability.

I've attached the mutual action plan and onboarding checklist for your review.

Next steps: Monica to propose first two dates, I will hand off the MOP and technical notes, Javier to confirm VPC/network windows with your infra team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: INTERNAL: AcuityHealth onboarding intake (ACU-2026-011) — owners & risks

Internal only — please do not forward to the customer.

Summary: Deal ACU-2026-011 closed 2026-02-09. Customer signed quote attached. Kickoff window requested: Feb 22–26.

Owners/roles (proposed):
- Monica Patel: CS lead (primary contact, run the weekly cadence, owns success plan and adoption milestones)
- Marissa Cole: Implementation engineer (data ingestion mappings, pre-kickoff validation, run test ingest)
- Sean Gallagher: Account exec (exec sponsor, will cover contract/escrow items if needed)

Key considerations / risks:
- Network/VPC work: Javier (customer) will coordinate with our infra on firewall rules. We need to reserve an on-call infra slot the week of Feb 15 to validate connectivity tests.
- Data sensitivity: customer indicates PHI-adjacent payloads; confirm whether they will pseudonymize before test ingest. If not, ensure SOC 2 evidence and required DPA clauses are present before production ingest.
- Timeline squeeze: they want to begin validation in first week after kickoff — Marissa, I need a pre-kickoff checklist completed by Feb 18 so we can validate test ingest on Feb 19–20.

Attachments to drop into shared folder: onboarding checklist + mutual action plan + signed quote (links above).

Action items (owner | due):
- Monica | 2026-02-12: propose kickoff date + send initial agenda
- Marissa | 2026-02-18: complete pre-kickoff data intake checklist and sample mapping
- Sean | 2026-02-15: confirm we have SOC 2 attestation package available for customer
- Karthik | 2026-02-12: introduce Monica to customer (below) and confirm Javier's network windows

Flagging: potential need for a one-time onboarding credit if we need dedicated infra hours outside standard scope — I'll surface to finance if it looks necessary.

Thanks — Karthik

Hi Dana — Monica looped me in. Happy to take the implementation lead on the technical intake and test ingest. Short note on next steps and what we need from your side before the kickoff: 

Planned first-week cadence (we'll confirm on the calendar):
- Day 0 (kickoff): intro + scope alignment (30 min)
- Day 1–2: data mapping workshop with Marissa + Javier (60–90 min)
- Day 3–4: test ingest window and connectivity validation (hands-on)
- Day 5: review of initial outputs, flag issues, and plan sprint 1 tasks

Pre-kickoff items from Acuity (please upload to the shared Drive folder or reply to this thread):
- Sample payload files (anonymized preferred) — due 2026-02-18
- Network contact and preferred maintenance window for VPC peering/firewall changes — Javier or infra lead
- Any regulatory constraints / DPA redlines Procurement expects for pre-prod data

I have attached a short pre-kickoff checklist and will schedule the first-week cadence once Monica confirms a firm date. If Feb 22 works, propose kick at 10:00 AM PT on Feb 22.

We will mark the attached onboarding checklist as "live" and version it as we progress. If there are any changes to scope that require extra hours (e.g., non-standard data transforms or dedicated infra dev time), we'll surface those as a change request with an estimate.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
